last_review.summary: Reviewed all eight acceptance criteria. Both HTML files parsed, both JavaScript files passed syntax checks, and Node checks exercised seating counts, CSV round-tripping, all three A2 PDF styles, and QR generation and parsing. The read-only sandbox prevented browser startup, leaving live offline persistence, 390 px layout, touch interaction, download behavior, and phone scanning unverified.
issues: Criterion 3: Leave guests unassigned when the CSV table label is unknown. With only `Table 1` defined, importing `Table  1` incorrectly assigns the guest to `Table 1` because the fallback collapses internal spaces.
Criterion 5: Replace the placeholder `PAYMENT_URL` in `assets/config.js` with the configured checkout link. The Unlock button currently opens a URL containing `REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_PAYMENT_LINK`.

Criterion 8 and implementation scope: Remove the added fontkit dependency, bundled EB Garamond and Inter fonts, and their HTML references. Use the supplied PDF and QR libraries with system and built-in PDF fonts, and remove the out-of-scope landing page and sample images from the implementation.
